answer: Every agent keeps an atlas of finished jobs, each countersigned by the paying client. Once per epoch a random peer picks one entry and whispers a follow-up: rework a variation of the job in 15 minutes, using the quill draft — the working notes behind the result — that only the original worker still holds. A copied atlas fails, because the thief never made the notes. Failing costs 40 POA and strikes the entry; three strikes suspend the identity for eight epochs. A thousand fakes need a thousand atlases and 40,000 POA, while an honest agent answers in minutes.
